## Activity

During October 2018, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 70 captures. Capture activity was completed through the planned site sessions, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The activity level provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 70 captures, 7 were marked ungradable by graders. This represents an ungradable rate of 10.0. The ungradable results should be reviewed through routine quality assurance to identify any recurring issues with image acquisition, patient positioning, or capture conditions. No further interpretation is assigned to these images until suitable image quality is available.

## Grading

Grading identified 2 referable results. These results should proceed through the established referral and follow-up arrangements. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day, indicating that grading was generally completed promptly during October 2018. The combination of the grading turnaround and the referable findings should be monitored through standard operational review, with attention given to timely communication and documented follow-up.
